statement: NVIDIA claims Vera Rubin delivers 35x lower token cost than Grace Blackwell Ultra.
why: Cheaper tokens make more applications economic, which historically drives total inference volume up faster than price comes down.

impact.mechanism: A large drop in cost per token expands the set of workloads that clear their economics, raising token volume and, with it, aggregate accelerator demand.

evidence.source: Investing.com earnings call transcript (NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: delivering 30x higher throughput per megawatt and 35x lower token cost relative to Grace Blackwell Ultra

confidence.basis: Vendor claim relayed in a third-party transcript; relative multiple with no stated workload, price point or independent verification.
